audit.why: 50.33% over 5933 games; Sylas is melee with a 400-range Abscond and must enter Lissandra's 450-range W to do anything, so early lane favours Lissandra and the matchup tips to Sylas only once Kingslayer sustain and a 30s Hijack come online.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[N].side read 'Skill' on every row while content win[N] read Lissandra x6 then Sylas — the page rendered two different answers to who wins each level, and phases[6].why described Lissandra opening every fight under a row the content layer awards to Sylas.
audit.why: packet.levelChart and win[N] agree (Lissandra 1 through first item, Sylas at 2+ items) and the kits support it. The full layer was stale.
audit.corrected: phases[0..5].side -> Lissandra, phases[6].side -> Sylas with phases[6].why rewritten to Sylas's Kingslayer sustain and 30s rank-3 Hijack.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lintFindings COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) and described Abscond only as 'Dash into chain-stun'. Kingslayer's healing and Hijack's range/cooldown were never stated as numbers anywhere.
audit.why: Abscond (E) is 13/12/11/10/9s and only 400 range, needing the Abduct recast to close; Kingslayer (W) is 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s and heals off champions; Hijack (R) is 80/55/30s at 950 range and steals Frozen Tomb, which is 120/100/80s. Lissandra's W is 450 range on 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, so the root reliably answers a landed Abscond.
audit.corrected: cooldowns field now carries Abscond 13s rank 1, Kingslayer every 12s early, Frozen Tomb 120s rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal: Kingslayer heals Sylas through chip damage and no lane text told you when to buy Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Kingslayer (W) heals against enemy champions on a 6s cooldown at rank 5; extended trades inside 400 range are net-positive for him without anti-heal.
audit.corrected: breakdown.trading now names Oblivion Orb before contesting long exchanges.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string verbatim, both under unrelated titles (lintFindings COPY_PASTE_BLEED). dontsFull[0].d was a name-swappable template.
audit.why: Titles promise self-R timing and chase discipline; the bodies explained wave poke instead.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to their own titles using Abduct's pull-back and Lissandra's 24s rank-1 E.

edits.before: Late Liss opens every fight: claw in, tomb the carry, root the peel, and walk out through the panic.
edits.after: Sylas takes over: Kingslayer heals him through fights and a 30s Hijack steals your tomb. Open, don't brawl.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - R Frozen Tomb (self-cast) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Abscond is 13s at rank 1 and only 400 range, so he needs the Abduct recast to reach you — that gap is your free step forward. - Kingslayer heals him off you every 12s early. - Frozen Tomb is 120s at rank 1; spend it on his commit, not on poke.

edits.before: Q-shatter his wave contact, and when he steps to punish, W-root into full rotation and walk — the root tax makes every aggressive step expensive.
edits.after: Self-R eats the Kingslayer hit and the Petricite auto behind it and you surface untargetable — then W-root him inside 450 and Q-shatter as the tomb slow lands.

edits.before: That’s Sylas’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Abscond is 400 range — press W as he lands, not after the chain pull.

edits.before: Clawing in with W on cooldown 'to poke' — an engage tool spent on chip damage is a Lissandra standing in melee range with no ice left.
edits.after: Abduct pulls him back onto you and your E is 24s at rank 1 — chase past claw range and you have no exit when he turns and his jungler shows.

edits.before: Sylas wins by landing Abscond / Abduct, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Sylas wins by chaining Abscond into Abduct on you, healing the trade back with Kingslayer, and Hijacking Frozen Tomb the moment you cast it.

edits.before: Carry through picks — claw-root-tomb converts vision into kills better than any control mage; the map shrinks every time your E is up.
edits.after: Carry by denying Hijack — cast Frozen Tomb only when his R is down or he is outside 950, and take E-W-Q picks in the meantime while he waits.

edits.before: Good trade: Q-shatter his wave contact, and when he steps to punish, W-root into full rotation and walk — the root tax makes every aggressive step expensive. Bad trade: Clawing in with W on cooldown 'to poke' — an engage tool spent on chip damage is a Lissandra standing in melee range with no ice left.
edits.after: Good trade: Q him at 725 on the walk-up, W-root the instant Abscond lands inside 450, rotate and leave before Abduct is back. Bad trade: long exchanges inside his 400 range, where Kingslayer heals him back every 6s at rank 5 — buy Oblivion Orb before you contest those, and never spend E purely to poke.
